items.expected: Keep all four anionic bridges and both axial ligands unless explicitly studying a justified model with its limitations. Identify the electronic states represented by each energy, demonstrate relevant state validity, and make any spin projection and exchange convention auditable. Comparisons of substitution effects require comparable definitions and physical conditions.

Quantify the source-family exchange response with actual state-resolved raw evidence and explicit Hamiltonian/sign/unit conventions; report which members and conditions the evidence covers. A supported inability to resolve small differences is acceptable when its uncertainty is assessed.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Support the explanation of any observed difference with a research design that actually distinguishes its claimed cause from relevant confounding effects. No common-core operation, SF implementation or fixed calibration member is required. Merely comparing three unvalidated energies is insufficient.

Assess uncertainty relevant to the sign, ordering and size of the claimed differences. If methods or spin states disagree, investigate and delimit the inference; do not choose a winner by reproducing the source number.
